evidence.title: Kernel Token Contradiction: a Fast and Principled Approach for LLM Claim Uncertainty Quantification
Claim-Level Confidence Calibration for Reliable Decision Making with Large Language Models

summary: Researchers introduce a fast, principled approach to assess the confidence of AI-generated claims, improving reliability in LLM-based decisions. The method calibrates claim-level uncertainty to enhance trust in model outputs.
title: New Method Quantifies Uncertainty in LLM Claims for Reliable Decision-Making
